answer.summary: Section 2 of docs/design/prototype-plan.md no longer names the local path and now says Hallmanac/coanda has been public since 2026-11-06 under Apache 2.0. The commit touches only that file and only section 2. I rewrote the ledger-refs parenthetical to match the repository being public, and left the 'Created only on Brian's go at a terminal' sentence as it was because of the non-goal.
